title_sq: Shitet apartament 1+1 tek Fusha e Aviacionit
description_sq:
Ish fusha e aviacionit, shitet apartament 1+1, kati i 5 banimi pallati i ri me 2 ashensor, afer bar Agron. Apartamenti eshte i investuar . I perbere nga salloni dhe guzhinë e gatimit, dhomë gjumi, tualet me dritare, depo. 
Me pamje nga pedonalja. 
Cmimi 120000 euro.Me hipotekë. 
Nuk shitet me kredi.
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale at the Aviation Field
description_en: Former aviation field, 1+1 apartment for sale, 5th floor of a new residential building with 2 elevators, near Agron bar. The apartment is invested. Consisting of living room and kitchen, bedroom, bathroom with window, storage room. Overlooking the pedestrian walkway. The price is 120,000 euros. With a mortgage. Not sold on credit.
